LanguageData.ColumbariumMakeUrn.label: make empty urn
LanguageData.ColumbariumMakeUrn.description: Make an empty urn for a colonist's remains.
LanguageData.ColumbariumFillUrn.label: cremate colonist into urn
LanguageData.ColumbariumFillUrn.description: Cremate a colonist and produce an installable memorial urn that can also be stored in a columbarium.
LanguageData.ColumbariumFillUrnCampfire.label: cremate colonist into urn at campfire
LanguageData.ColumbariumFillUrnCampfire.description: Cremate a colonist at a campfire using 150 wood and an empty urn. This takes about 12 hours at normal labor speed.
